selected_prior_decisions.review: Table 20 permits distinct StmF and StrF names; Table 27 requires recipient arrays for filters named by either default; Table 25 associates a key with each crypt-filter name. ADR 2802's current location rule (StrF only if StmF is Identity) is narrower than those source statements. The test draft adds a distinct-key positive and a shared-default positive control and independently checks CMS/AES fixture plaintext with OpenSSL. Parent execution/review is still required before promoting a finding.

interpretation_boundaries: An effective EC3 correction may add a producer validity rule without creating a mandatory reader rejection rule.
A clause/table version label corrected by errata is not itself an instruction to gate reader processing on the document's declared PDF version.
A citation to a test file or broad feature row is not treated as proof of the precise erratum case unless the assertion body exercises that case.
